title: [Peek] Add preview support for EML and MSG email files

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: A new isolated pristine baseline is pinned to the exact upstream head; the previous unexpectedly modified baseline was preserved. The baseline restore process then started, but its private wrapper failed while assigning the process ID to a reserved PowerShell variable and released the exclusive lock before confirming child termination. No matching process remained at the subsequent check, but no exit code or output was captured, so this is not a successfully serialized restore result. Post-hoc inspection found all ten managed assets and all 56 pinned managed package identities and hashes; the two expected native package archives were absent. Candidate restore was not run and native cache pins remained unchanged. Wrapper lifetime handling and the native prerequisite contract are under source-only repair. No product build, adapter discovery or product-assembly test completed.
